questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Forces Acting on Particle and Rigid Body
questions.text: State and explain Newton's Laws of Motion, Parallelogram Law of Forces, Principle of Transmissibility of Forces, and Varignon's Theorem of Moments. Determine the resultant magnitude, direction, and line of action of a 2D coplanar non-concurrent force system.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Forces Acting on Particle and Rigid Body
questions.text: Explain Free Body Diagrams (FBD) and Equations of Static Equilibrium ($\sum F_x = 0, \sum F_y = 0, \sum M = 0$). Analyze a pin-jointed plane truss: Calculate support reactions and member forces using Method of Joints and Method of Sections.
Explain Laws of Dry Friction (Coulomb Friction: $F = \mu N$). Define Angle of Friction, Angle of Repose, and Cone of Friction. Solve problems on Ladder Friction and Wedge Friction.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Centre of Gravity, Centroid, Moment of Inertia, and Mass Moment of Inertia
questions.text: Define Centroid, Center of Gravity, and Moment of Inertia (Second Moment of Area). State Parallel Axis Theorem ($I_x = I_G + A d^2$) and Perpendicular Axis Theorem. Calculate centroid $(\bar{x}, \bar{y})$ and moment of inertia ($I_{xx}, I_{yy}$) for composite standard sections (T-section, I-section, L-section).

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Kinematics of Particles (Rectilinear and Curvilinear Motion)
questions.text: Explain Kinematics and Kinetics of Particles: Rectilinear and Curvilinear motion (Normal and Tangential components), D'Alembert's Principle, Work-Energy Principle ($W_{1-2} = \Delta KE$), and Principle of Impulse and Momentum. Solve for velocity and acceleration of connected bodies.
